## Outcome / authority
- Link original user request and its accepted corrections:
- Owner and canonical issue:
- Intended diff; explicit non-goals:

## Verification (actual evidence only)
- [ ] Current source, base/head and original requirements inspected
- [ ] Build/test commands recorded with actual output and exact commit
- [ ] Runtime/device/consumer verification recorded or specifically marked unverified
- [ ] Existing capabilities reused only after consumer proof
- [ ] No secrets, unchecked publication, or unreviewed deletion
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_starter.py --mode ready .` passed, **or** unresolved placeholders explicitly block readiness
- [ ] All unresolved review threads and required approval gates satisfied

## Handoff
- Changed files and artifacts:
- Known failures and gaps:
- Next useful action / rollback point:

- [ ] Applicable UI policy, palette/accessibility and target runtime evidence recorded (or reasoned headless scope in UI.md).
- [ ] Architecture, reuse/provenance, security and changelog updated where affected; unresolved checks are explicit gaps, not claimed passes.
